results.title: Parliament scrap plans to hold 2027 Budget workshop outside parliamentary premises
results.content: Parliament has abandoned plans to hold its post-budget workshop in the Volta Region, opting to organise the exercise at the Chamber of Parliament in Accra following opposition from the Minority, as preparations begin for a week of debate on the 2027 Budget Statement and Economic Policy.

results.title: Accra Academy 95th anniversary gala to honour 40 recipients, raise funds for school projects
results.content: Accra Academy will honour 40 individuals, groups and organisations at its 95th anniversary dinner, awards and fundraising gala on Saturday, November 14, 2026. The event, scheduled for 7:00 p.m. at the Ridge Church Main Auditorium in Accra, will be held under the theme, “A Legacy of Pride, Purpose, and Achievements”. A major part of the celebration will be a fundraising drive to support the construction of residential flats for school staff and the refurbishment of the K.G. Konuah Assembly Hall. The school says the projects are intended to improve staff welfare and provide a more conducive environment for teachers living on campus.

results.title: Prof. Bokpin urges gov’t to increase infrastructure spending to drive economic growth
results.content: A Professor of Finance and Economics at the University of Ghana Business School, Prof. Godfred Bokpin, has urged the government to reconsider its fiscal framework and increase investment in infrastructure, saying that inadequate public spending could undermine its ambition to achieve private sector-led economic growth.

results.title: Samira Bawumia launches solar power initiative for underserved maternity facilities in Africa
results.content: Former Second Lady Samira Bawumia has launched an initiative to provide reliable solar electricity to underserved healthcare facilities in Africa, initially focusing on improving maternal and newborn care in Ghana. The initiative, known as the Powering Safe Delivery Initiative, will equip selected Community-based Health Planning and Services (CHPS) compounds, maternity facilities and primary healthcare centres with solar photovoltaic systems, battery storage and essential maternal healthcare infrastructure. It was unveiled at a high-level side event at the World Health Organisation (WHO) Pavilion during the COP31 climate conference in Antalya, Türkiye. The Africa Women and Youth Climate Centre (AFRYWOCC), founded by Mrs Bawumia, was established in collaboration with the Centre for Climate Change and Sustainability Studies (C3SS) at the University of Ghana and Minagie Energy. results.title: Prof. Bokpin urges gov’t to use PPPs to fund major road projects and free up resources for social infrastructure
results.content: Professor of Finance and Economics at the University of Ghana Business School, Prof. Godfred Bokpin, has urged the government to adopt Public-Private Partnerships (PPPs) to finance major road infrastructure projects, saying that the approach would ease pressure on public finances and free up funds for schools, hospitals and other essential services across the country.

results.title: Gov’t has not abandoned PPPs; it seeks to fast-track projects before private sector participation – Theo Acheampong
results.content: Technical Advisor to the Finance Minister, Dr Theophilus Acheampong, has dismissed suggestions that the government is moving away from Public-Private Partnerships (PPPs), explaining that its decision to use public funds to drive some major infrastructure projects is intended to speed up delivery.

results.title: 100% local processing of cocoa beans achievable but requires political will – Dr Opoku Gakpo
results.content: Agricultural analyst Dr Joseph Opoku Gakpo says the government’s plan to ensure 100 per cent of Ghana’s raw cocoa beans are processed locally by 2030 is achievable, provided it has strong political will.

results.title: UN welcomes Kofi Annan’s appearance on new GH¢100 banknote
results.content: The United Nations in Ghana has welcomed the decision to feature former UN Secretary-General Kofi Annan on the Bank of Ghana’s newly introduced GH¢100 banknote, describing it as recognition of his enduring contribution to global peace and diplomacy.

results.title: Owabi treatment plant shutdown disrupts water supply to parts of Ashanti Region
results.content: Residents in several communities in the Ashanti Region are expected to experience water supply interruptions after Ghana Water Limited (GWL) temporarily shut down the Owabi Water Treatment Plant following heavy rainfall.

results.title: Mahama pledges dialogue to resolve UTAG-GTEC dispute
results.content: President John Mahama says the government is prepared to engage the University Teachers Association of Ghana (UTAG) and the Ghana Tertiary Education Commission (GTEC) to resolve disagreements over the regulation of tertiary institutions.

results.title: US$200m chicken import bill puts local poultry production in focus – Forson
results.content: Finance Minister Dr Cassiel Ato Forson has questioned Ghana’s annual spending of about US$200 million on chicken imports, arguing that local maize and soybean production could support a stronger domestic poultry industry.

results.title: Gov’t plans 3% discount on GoldBod’s gold purchases after taking over programme costs from BoG
results.content: The government plans to introduce a 3% discount on small-scale gold purchases in 2027 to reduce the cost of accumulating foreign exchange and building reserves through domestic gold purchases.

results.title: Peasant agriculture cannot solve Ghana’s food problems – Ato Forson
results.content: Finance Minister Dr Cassiel Ato Forson says Ghana must move beyond peasant agriculture and modernise food production to reduce its dependence on imports.

results.title: Kofi Arko Nokoe joins MCE to oversee second PWD support disbursement in Nzema East
results.content: The Member of Parliament for Evalue-Ajomoro-Gwira, Kofi Arko Nokoe, has joined the Municipal Chief Executive (MCE) for Nzema East,Kuah Dickson, to oversee the disbursement of support to Persons with Disabilities (PWDs) in the municipality.

results.title: 2027 Budget: Promised 24-hour economy incentives still missing
results.content: The 2027 Budget does not specify several incentives proposed to attract businesses into Ghana’s 24-hour economy programme; instead, it outlines a narrower set of tax measures for participating enterprises.

results.title: Samira Bawumia champions solar-powered healthcare, clean cooking at COP31
results.content: Former Second Lady of Ghana, Hajia Samira Bawumia, has called for increased investment in solar-powered healthcare systems and clean cooking solutions, highlighting their importance in protecting women and children from the health effects of climate change.
